title: Realism Rewrite Benchmark for Scheming Evals

original_idea.body: # Realism Rewrite Benchmark for Scheming Evals. Hand-author realistic twins of ~15 scheming scenarios, run open models on both halves, measure the misaligned-behavior gap, release the paired benchmark.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying artificiality confound strengthens load-bearing scheming-eval measurements.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Hand-authoring realistic twins + running on open models; guided, mostly prompt engineering.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused paired-benchmark deliverable but authoring 15 twins is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Released paired benchmark for eval validity, public scenarios; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Realism-rewrite effect studied; a paired synthetic-vs-realistic benchmark plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Rewrite effect known but no paired benchmark; angle plausibly open.
